ref: ADR-0008 XSD (the branches of a choice become sibling fields; effective occurrence is the product of every enclosing particle's occurrence) and "Refused when a mapping uses the field" (a repeated group of two or more particles is refused in a target unless it is a choice of single elements); spec #89, ticket #94
note: picks.xsd holds a repeated choice of the single elements A and B, so each is 0..unbounded and the target is not refused. A copies every Id and B every Sku, each in context Orders: streamed output writes every A, then every B, which the repeated choice allows. Also a differential case: the exported XSLT gives the same output.
